user.title: RoomMind
user.description: Set up RoomMind to manage room climate. Rooms are configured in the RoomMind panel after setup.

init.title: RoomMind options
init.description: Configure vacation behaviour and the AC inverter setpoint strategy.

data_description.vacation_action: "Setback" heats to the vacation temperature. "Off" disables active heating (frost protection only); cooling continues to track eco cool.
data_description.vacation_frost_temp: Lowest temperature kept while heating is off during vacation.
data_description.ac_setpoint_strategy: "Boost" ramps the AC setpoint toward the device limit (legacy). "Offset" shifts the comfort target by at most the offsets below, letting an inverter modulate gently. TRV/underfloor heating is unaffected.
data_description.ac_cool_offset_max: At full demand, cool to this many K below the cool target.
data_description.ac_heat_offset_max: At full demand, AC-heat to this many K above the heat target.
data_description.idle_off_after_minutes: When a room stays comfortable, hold setback this long, then fully turn the device off. 0 disables (pure setback). Auto-recovers when heating/cooling is needed again.
data_description.demand_control_enabled: RoomMind drives the shared outdoor unit's demand cap from outdoor temp + aggregate room demand. Replaces any external demand automation. Off = selects untouched (default).
data_description.demand_select_entities: The demand-control select entities of the compressor group (one per indoor unit).
data_description.demand_min: Lowest demand cap RoomMind will set (also used when the group is idle).
data_description.demand_max: Highest demand cap RoomMind will set.
data_description.demand_hysteresis: Don't re-apply demand changes smaller than this (anti-flutter).
data_description.demand_min_hold_minutes: Minimum time between demand changes (anti short-cycle of the cap).
data_description.demand_down_hold_minutes: Anti ping-pong: only lower the demand cap after the rooms have stayed satisfied this long. Demand still rises immediately to cover heat need. 0 = off (legacy).

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm_restart.description: RoomMind {version} has been installed but Home Assistant is still running an older version. Restart to complete the update.
